description: First-time deploy of service with secrets on production — canary + quorum overlap (highest tier wins)

playbook.content:
- name: Deploy secrets-dependent service
  hosts: prod
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.include_vars:
        file: vault_secrets.yml
    - ansible.builtin.service:
        name: secret-dependent-svc
        state: started

tier_rationale: is_new_service + involves_secrets on prod → quorum-required (highest tier wins over canary)
